  162|    public static function q(string $sql, array $params = []): PDOStatement
  163|    {
  164|        $raw = self::raw($sql);
  165|        try {
  166|            $st = self::pdo()->prepare($raw);
  167|            $st->execute($params);
  168|            return $st;
  169|        } catch (PDOException $e) {
  170|            $inTx = false;
  171|            try { $inTx = self::pdo()->inTransaction(); } catch (Throwable $x) {}
  172|
  173|            if (!$inTx && self::retryable($e)) {
  174|                $emu = self::emu();
  175|                if ($emu instanceof PDO) {
  176|                    try {
  177|                        $st = $emu->prepare($raw);
  178|                        $st->execute($params);
  179|                        if (function_exists('app_log')) {
  180|                            app_log('db', 'retry-emulate | ' . mb_substr(trim((string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $raw)), 0, 160));
  181|                        }
  182|                        return $st;
  183|                    } catch (PDOException $e2) {
  184|                        $fresh = self::retryFresh($raw, $params);
  185|                        if ($fresh instanceof PDOStatement) return $fresh;
  186|                        throw self::wrap($e2, $raw);
  187|                    }
  188|                }
  189|            }
  190|            if (!$inTx && self::retryable($e)) {
  191|                $fresh = self::retryFresh($raw, $params);
  192|                if ($fresh instanceof PDOStatement) return $fresh;
  193|            }
  194|            throw self::wrap($e, $raw);
  195|        }
  196|    }

  538|    public static function run(): array
  539|    {
  540|        $lines = [];

  545|            try {
